data.name: Dreamwalker
data.description: A dreamstalker treats dreamscapes as a favored terrain, as per the ranger ability, gaining a +%1 bonus. While in a dreamscape, she also treats any creature from the Dimension of Dreams (including dreamed figments) as her favored enemy, with a +%2 bonus.|DreamwalkerEnemyBonus*2|DreamwalkerEnemyBonus

raw_tokens.value: A dreamstalker treats dreamscapes as a favored terrain, as per the ranger ability, gaining a +%1 bonus. While in a dreamscape, she also treats any creature from the Dimension of Dreams (including dreamed figments) as her favored enemy, with a +%2 bonus.|DreamwalkerEnemyBonus*2|DreamwalkerEnemyBonus
SkillBonus|You gain a +%1 bonus on Knowledge (Geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks, Initiative checks and cannot be tracked in dreamscapes|DreamwalkerEnemyBonus*2
SkillBonus|You gain a +%1 bonus on Bluff, Knowledge, Perception, Sense Motive, and Survival checks against creature from the Dimension of Dreams|DreamwalkerEnemyBonus
CombatBonus|You gain a +%1 bonus on Attack rolls and Damage rolls against creature from the Dimension of Dreams|DreamwalkerEnemyBonus
